f_definition.type: odd linear map f: g -> g
f_definition.origin: oscillator shift b_k^s -> b_k^s + kappa*(gb_{+,k,s} a_1^- + gb_{-,k,s} a_1^+); phi(Z) = Z + kappa F(Z); f = -F
f_definition.formula_even: f(Z) = -(sum over boson letters of Z) of the letter replaced by its shift (normal-ordered, kappa leftmost)
f_definition.K_component: f(Z) has a K-component lambda(Z) for odd Z; it is NOT part of the g-valued map and is stored in f_K_component

f_map.description: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_ij Z_i ; stored as {Z_j: {Z_i: phi_ij}} (g-valued part)

f_K_component.description: lambda(Z) = K-coefficient of f(Z) (nonzero only for odd Z); not used in coboundary.entries

coboundary.description: (delta f)(X,Y) = sum_Z coeff * Z for the g-valued f; all ordered pairs with nonzero value

K_extension.description: extra terms -lambda([X,Y]) K that delta(f + lambda K) would add; compare with the Z=K entries of Layer 3
